findings.summary: Architectural interface IF1 and Component C3 do not explicitly list the 'structured handoff bundle' as a required input, creating a traceability gap with Requirement R1 which mandates it.

evidence.note: R1 explicit requirement for handoff bundle input.
evidence.quote: accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json (plus its associated structured handoff bundle)

evidence.note: IF1 contract lists only plan package and contexts, omitting the handoff bundle.
C3 Intake Gate responsibilities do not mention validating an upstream handoff bundle.
evidence.quote: Validate plan_package_final.json, repo_context.json, workspace_context.json against schemas.
